#4 added (here) a few more references on quantum simulation of non-abelian anyons, such as pointer to this recent article:

  • Mohsin Iqbal et al.: Universal gates from braiding and fusing anyons on quantum hardware, Nature 655 (2026) 591–597 (2026) [doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10709-y, arXiv:2601.20956]

and I added quotes below articles where authors explicitly admit that this is just a simulation of anyons (and be it a quantum simulation), such as in:

  • Shibo Xu et al.: Non-Abelian braiding of Fibonacci anyons with a superconducting processor, Nature Physics 20 (2024) 1469–1475 [doi:10.1038/s41567-024-02529-6]

“we use the idea of digital quantum simulation to implement creations and braidings of Fibonacci anyons […] the braidings carried out in our experiment involve no Hamiltonian dynamics of quasiparticle excitations. As a result, they are not endowed with topological protection that naturally arises from an energy gap separating the many-body degenerate ground states from the low-lying excited states”
